title: Business Names (Amendment) Act, 2024
text:
Business Names
BELIZE:
BUSINESS NAMES (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2024
ARRANGEMENT OF SECTIONS
1. Short title.
2. Amendment of section 7A.
3. Amendment of Schedule.
4. Insertion of new Schedule II.

No. 36] Business Names 615
No. 36 of 2024
I assent,
H. E. Dame Froyla Tzalam
Governor-General
9th December, 2024.
AN ACT to amend the Business Names Act, Chapter 247
of the Substantive Laws of Belize, Revised Edition
2020; to make a Certificate of Registration valid for one
year; and to provide for matters connected therewith
or incidental thereto.
(Gazetted 14th December, 2024)
BE IT ENACTED, by and with the advice and consent of
the House of Representatives and Senate of Belize and
by the authority of the same, as follows:
1. This Act may be cited as the Short title.
BUSINESS NAMES (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2024,

616 Business Names [No. 36
CAP. 247. and shall be read and construed as one with the Business
Names Act, is hereinafter referred to as the principal Act.
Amendment of 2. Section 7A of the principal Act is amended–
section 7A.
(a) in sub-section (1), by deleting the words “two
years” and substituting the words “one year”;
and
(b) by inserting after sub-section (3), the following
new sub-section–
“(3A) Upon renewal of a Certificate of
Registration by a firm or person, the Registrar
shall issue a detailed extract as set out in
Schedule II.”.
Amendment of 3. The Schedule of the principal Act is amended by
Schedule.
renumbering the Schedule as Schedule I.

new Schedule
